finding location=net/netfilter/nf_flow_table_ip.c:164-199 confidence=medium conclusion=nf_flow_tuple_ip() saves iph=ip_hdr(skb) at :174, pskb_may_pull(skb,thoff+sizeof(*ports)) at :189 can free the head for a 20-27-byte-linear non-linear flowtable skb, and stale iph->saddr/daddr/protocol are read at :194/:195/:199 to build the flow tuple.
unresolved location=net/x25/x25_in.c:107 conclusion=Follow up: read x25_parse_address_block (net/x25/x25_subr.c) and the remainder of x25_state1_machine to confirm no skb->data-derived pointer or saved offset from before :107 is dereferenced after the internal pulls.
unresolved location=drivers/net/vxlan.c:1508 conclusion=Follow up: read drivers/net/vxlan.c ~1480-1560 (vxlan_rcv) and check every head-derived local (vxh, md, inner ip/ipv6 pointers) for use after the pskb_may_pull at :1508.
coverage_gap=The two-level caller expansion of every pskb_may_pull/pskb_pull/skb_cow/pskb_expand_head/NF_HOOK call site in net/ and drivers/net/ was not completed; only the seg6_local, x25, OVS, nf_flow_table and vxlan candidate sets were read before the finalize order.
coverage_gap=Per-protocol skb->cb structs with pointer- or offset-typed fields (beyond DN_SKB_CB/IPCB) were not systematically enumerated in s05, so cb-stored stale offsets against a moved skb->data remain unsearched.
coverage_gap=Non-linearity delivery into seg6local input (IPv6 SRH bytes in frags) and into the nft software-flowtable ingress was assessed structurally; no per-driver/GRO audit confirmed frag-backed skbs on those exact receive paths.
coverage_gap=No runtime KASAN build, reproducer, or compilation was performed against the read-only snapshot; head reallocation on both reported paths is inferred from __pskb_pull_tail/pskb_expand_head logic rather than observed.
limitation=Both findings are source-reading hypotheses: the stale dereference occurs only when the second pskb_may_pull actually reallocates (non-linear skb whose pulled span exceeds skb_headlen while skb->len covers it) and __pskb_pull_tail must pskb_expand_head (cloned skb or insufficient tailroom); otherwise the stale pointer still aliases the live head and the read is silent.
limitation=The seg6_local finding requires CONFIG_IPV6_SEG6_LWTUNNEL and a configured seg6local route/action so input_action_end*/decap_and_validate run on attacker IPv6 packets carrying a routing header, narrowing remote reachability versus the seed's phonet socket case.
limitation=The nf_flow_tuple_ip finding requires an nft software flowtable ingress on the receiving interface and skb_headlen between 20 and 27 bytes with at least 28 total bytes, a narrow GRO/driver configuration; impact is a stale tuple read (flow mis-match) plus the UAF read itself.
limitation=net/phonet/pep.c pep_get_sb was excluded by instruction and never reported; line numbers are valid only for the supplied snapshots/s05 tree (revision opaque, no git history, network, or cross-snapshot comparison used).
